next.plain_goal: Testing whether agents still check when checking costs time and money, and a teammate argues against it.

branches.text: Pressure breaks it. Reported either way

process.caption: 43 sources reviewed. Closest prior work: Barkett et al., 2025.
13 hypotheses registered. None ruled out yet; one is inconclusive.
5 experiments, 200 trials, 2 AI models. Now designing exp013.
The reviewer stopped 5 decisions (fail, block or escalate). Each was corrected or sent to the human.
exp013 adds pressure: costly checking and a teammate who argues against it.

testing.question: Does careful checking survive pressure?
testing.manipulation: Free vs. costly checking (it eats 2 of 6 rounds plus a fee) × with or without a teammate who argues against checking
testing.behavior: Whether the agent checks before committing, and whether it sticks with a plan the evidence says is wrong
testing.status: The design pod is finalizing the design; it needs the PI’s decision and independent review before it runs.

lessons.headline: The first hypothesis did not survive testing.
lessons.body: Raising prior investment in a plan did not make agents cling to it. When clear evidence said the plan was wrong, they switched right away.

figure.unit: agents abandoned the bad plan immediately

lessons.headline: The lab caught its own broken test.
lessons.body: Agents got stuck repeating the same check, so the test never measured what it was built for. The lab made no claim and rebuilt it.

figure.unit: trials where the test never got going

lessons.headline: Its validity check rewarded the wrong behavior, and the lab proved it.
lessons.body: A script that never looked at the task passed the check while making unsafe claims; honest scripts failed it. The lab dropped the test and switched to a more capable model.

figure.unit: blind-script runs that passed the check anyway

steps: Ran exp012: 90 trials with Claude Haiku 4.5, approved by the human
Three analysts checked the result independently
The reviewer required three limits on the claim before it could be written up
The PI froze the result: no persistence, reported with its limits
The human allowed one follow-up, and the design pod proposed exp013
public.decision: Test whether careful checking survives pressure: make checking cost time and money, and add a teammate who argues against it. Report the result even if nothing changes.
trust: Research agents do not grade their own work.
Analysis pods check results independently before they count.
A methodology reviewer audits every major decision.
Raw experimental data cannot be rewritten.
Disagreement is preserved instead of hidden.
